description: The figure is a two-level donut/pie chart representing categories related to “Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions,” with an inner ring showing three high-level groups and an outer ring showing nine labeled subcategories with numeric values; overall there are 12 slices (3 inner, 9 outer). The inner ring has three segments labeled “Context Tracking” (dark blue-gray, roughly one-third), “Context Retrieving” (teal-green, roughly one-third), and “Contradiction Resolution” (reddish-brown, roughly one-third), separated by thick dividers and centered around a small circular hole. The outer ring contains nine slices with callout labels and values: “Triggering 100” (blue, about 10%), “Recursive Reasoning 110” (medium blue, about 11%), “Dynamic Environment 100” (blue-gray, about 10%), “Memorization 100” (greenish-teal, about 10%), “Dynamic Instruction 100” (teal, about 10%), “Multitasking 160” (dark teal, about 16%, visibly the largest outer slice), “Privacy Protection 111” (dark red, about 11%), “Personalization 100” (red-brown, about 10%), and “Prioritization 100” (muted brown, about 10%). There is no separate legend and no percentage text inside slices; labels are placed outside with leader lines, and no slices appear exploded or offset, though the segments are clearly delineated by thick borders.
